Attached: 1 image

An agent is only as capable as the tools you describe to it. Ours got three: web_search, image_search, save_to_file. That was enough for it to research a topic, pick images, and write a full markdown post on its own, in plain Ruby with no framework. The loop is the easy part. The tool descriptions are where the real design work lives. https://go.upgradejs.com/tw3 #Ruby #AIAgents #LLM
